header: What changed in the first quarter after the changeover
lead: Every company below runs Larkmoor Depot as its only stock system. We asked each of them for one sentence and printed it as it came back.

quotes.quote_text: The counter can promise a delivery date now without walking to the back. That sounds small until you count how often a day it used to happen.
quotes.author: Katrin Weissgruber

quotes.quote_text: Stocktaking used to close us for a Saturday. Last year we counted two aisles a week on a handheld and never shut the doors at all.
quotes.author: Milan Prohaska

quotes.quote_text: I order against what we actually sold, not against what I remember selling. The reorder list has been wrong twice this year, and both times it was me.
quotes.author: Doris Ebner

quotes.quote_text: Our parts have four names each, depending on who is asking. Being able to keep all four and search on any of them is the feature nobody advertises.
quotes.author: Stefan Aigner

quotes.quote_text: Two of us run this shop. I did not want a system that assumes a purchasing department, and this one never asked whether we had one.
quotes.author: Lena Brandtner

quotes.quote_text: Dispatch prints the note, the customer signs on the screen, and the invoice leaves the same evening. Nothing is retyped anywhere in that sentence.
quotes.author: Tobias Reisinger
